---
title: "Find a variable"
subtitle: "Search every column in every register documented in this guide"
date: last-modified
---

[Overview of registers](register-reference.qmd) answers *"what is in this
register?"*. This page answers the opposite: *"which register has this
variable, and what does it look like there?"*

Search by column name, by what it means, or by register. Everything comes from
the same schema as the register tables, so the two pages cannot disagree.

::: {.callout-important}
**This is a starting point, not an authority.** The names, types and value sets
here are collected from DST's and Sundhedsdatastyrelsen's published
documentation, and they can be out of date or simply wrong. Codes change
meaning, columns are retired, and what is documented is the register, not what
your project ordered.

**Check two things before you rely on anything you find here.** The current
format tables on the DST server, which are the authoritative code lists and are
updated without this page knowing, and **your own delivered dataset** with
`colnames()` and a look at the actual values. A column can be missing from your
extract, spelled differently, or arrive as a type that changes what your code
does.

Found something wrong? [Open an
issue](https://github.com/steno-aarhus/registers-guide/issues) or use the
feedback box below. A mistake spotted once is a morning nobody else loses.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## What a result shows you

**Type** is the R type you get after loading. Where it says *unverified*, no
published source gives a type for that column and it was read off the name: DST
publishes data types for none of its registers, and only Sundhedsdatastyrelsen
does, for the health registers. Confirm with `sapply(class)` before relying on
it, especially for code columns, which lose their leading zeros if they arrive
as numbers.

**Years** is what DST or Sundhedsdatastyrelsen documents that they hold, not
what your project was delivered. It is shown only when a column covers a
different period from its register, which is the case worth noticing: a column
that stops in 2003 is a silent hole in a series that runs to 2024.

**Same name, several registers** is the reason this page exists. `koen` in BEF
is a number, `c_sex` in LPR2 changed coding in 2005, `borger_koen` in LPR3 is
text with an unknown value set. Three answers to one question, and the register
pages show them one at a time.

**The value set** is folded under each coded column: what `U` means in `civst`,
what `3` meant in `c_pattype` before 2014. Working that out is normally the slow
part, and where the codes are too many to list, the fold-out links to the
classification instead.

**Under the register name** you get how to join it, what period it covers, and a
warning if it is closed. A column in `dodsaars` is fine for causes of death and
wrong for censoring, and the search says so before you use it.

**Replaced by** marks a column with a successor, like `van_vtil`. Using it alone
leaves a silent hole in the middle of a series.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="varfind">
  <div class="vf-controls">
    <input id="vf-q" type="search" placeholder="Column name, meaning, or register - try: koen, income, diagnosis, atc"
           autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search variables">
    <div class="vf-filters">
      <select id="vf-reg" aria-label="Register"><option value="">All registers</option></select>
      <select id="vf-role" aria-label="Role"><option value="">Any role</option></select>
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="vf-key"> Only columns the guide uses</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="vf-inf"> Only unverified types</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="vf-part"> Only columns that start or stop mid-register</label>
    </div>
    <p id="vf-count" class="vf-count"></p>
  </div>
  <div id="vf-results"></div>
</div>

<style>
#varfind { margin: 1.5rem 0; }
#vf-q { width: 100%; padding: .6rem .8rem; font-size: 1.05rem; border-radius: 6px;
        border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
        color: var(--bs-body-color, #111); }
.vf-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem 1.25rem; align-items: center;
              margin: .75rem 0 .25rem; font-size: .9rem; }
.vf-filters select { padding: .3rem .4rem; border-radius: 5px;
                     border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc);
                     background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #111); }
.vf-filters label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; margin: 0; }
.vf-count { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .75; margin: .5rem 0 0; }
.vf-group { border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); padding: .9rem 0; }
.vf-name { font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; }
.vf-multi { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: .8; margin-left: .5rem; }
.vf-hit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.5rem 1fr; gap: .25rem .9rem;
          margin: .5rem 0 0 .25rem; font-size: .9rem; }
.vf-reg { font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); }
.vf-meta { opacity: .8; font-size: .85rem; }
.vf-tag { display: inline-block; padding: .05rem .4rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .75rem;
          border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-right: .3rem; }
.vf-warn { border-color: #b8860b; }
.vf-note { margin: .3rem 0 0; font-size: .85rem; opacity: .9; }
.vf-empty { padding: 1.5rem 0; opacity: .8; }
.vf-cs { margin: .45rem 0 0; font-size: .85rem; }
.vf-cs > summary { cursor: pointer; opacity: .85; }
.vf-codes { margin: .4rem 0 .2rem; font-size: .85rem; border-collapse: collapse; }
.vf-codes td { padding: .12rem .8rem .12rem 0; vertical-align: top; }
.vf-codes td:first-child { white-space: nowrap; }
.vf-da { opacity: .6; }
.vf-src { font-size: .8rem; opacity: .65; margin: .4rem 0 0; }
.vf-danger { border-left: 2px solid #b8860b; padding-left: .5rem; }
.vf-reg .vf-meta { margin-top: .15rem; }
@media (max-width: 620px) { .vf-hit { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var DATA = [], CS = {}, REG = {}, EXPAND = {}, byName = {};

  // Same stop words and synonym expansion as Search the guide, so the two
  // pages answer the same query the same way. Without it "indkomst" finds
  // nothing here while "income" does, purely because of which labels happened
  // to be in English.
  var STOP = ("a an and are as at be but by can do does for from has have how i " +
    "if in is it its me my of on or that the their then there they this to was " +
    "what when where which who why will with you your " +
    "af alle at bruge da de den der det dette du eller en er et for fra gør har " +
    "hvad hvor hvordan hvorfor hvilke hvilken i ikke jeg kan man med mig min mine " +
    "og om på selv skal som til ved vi").split(" ");
  var q = document.getElementById("vf-q"), reg = document.getElementById("vf-reg"),
      role = document.getElementById("vf-role"), onlyKey = document.getElementById("vf-key"),
      onlyInf = document.getElementById("vf-inf"), onlyPart = document.getElementById("vf-part"),
      out = document.getElementById("vf-results"), count = document.getElementById("vf-count");

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c];
    });
  }

  // Everything a reader might type: the column, its label, the register, the
  // code system AND its value labels, the note, and the register description.
  function haystack(v) {
    if (v._hay) return v._hay;
    var r = REG[v.register] || {}, cs = CS[v.code_system];
    v._hay = (v.name + " " + (v.label || "") + " " + v.register + " " +
      (v.register_name || "") + " " + (v.code_system || "") + " " +
      (v.note || "") + " " + (v.derivation || "") + " " +
      (r.description || "") + " " + (cs ? cs._text : "")).toLowerCase();
    return v._hay;
  }

  // A query term matches if it is in the haystack, or if a synonym of it is.
  // Prefix matching with a three-character floor handles Danish inflection.
  function expand(terms) {
    var all = terms.slice();
    Object.keys(EXPAND).forEach(function (term) {
      var hit = terms.some(function (w) {
        if (w === term) return true;
        if (term.length < 3 || w.length < 3) return false;
        if (w.indexOf(term) === 0) return w.length - term.length <= 6;
        if (term.indexOf(w) === 0) return term.length - w.length <= 6;
        return false;
      });
      if (hit) EXPAND[term].forEach(function (t) { if (all.indexOf(t) === -1) all.push(t); });
    });
    return all;
  }

  function matches(v, terms, expanded) {
    if (!terms.length) return true;
    var hay = haystack(v);
    // every typed word must be found, by itself or through a synonym
    return terms.every(function (t) {
      if (hay.indexOf(t) !== -1) return true;
      var grp = expanded[t];
      return grp && grp.some(function (x) { return hay.indexOf(x) !== -1; });
    });
  }

  // Every claim on this page comes from somewhere. Saying where lets a reader
  // decide whether to trust it, which matters most for the columns whose type
  // was read off the name rather than published anywhere.
  var SRC_LABEL = {
    dst_variable_list: "DST's variable list",
    dst_documentation: "Sundhedsdatastyrelsen's register documentation",
    nomenclature: "the classification itself",
    unverified: "no published source - treat as unverified",
    unknown: "no source recorded"
  };

  function sourceLine(v) {
    var bits = [];
    var lab = SRC_LABEL[v.src_type] || v.src_type;
    if (lab) {
      bits.push(v.src_url
        ? 'Name and label from <a href="' + esc(v.src_url) + '">' + esc(lab) + "</a>"
        : "Name and label from " + esc(lab));
    }
    if (v.type_inferred) {
      bits.push("<strong>type not published anywhere</strong>, read off the column name");
    } else if (v.type_source) {
      var m = v.type_source.match(/^(https?:\/\/\S+?)(?:,\s*(.*))?$/);
      bits.push(m
        ? 'type from <a href="' + esc(m[1]) + '">' +
            esc(m[2] || m[1].replace(/^https?:\/\/([^/]+).*$/, "$1")) + "</a>"
        : "type from " + esc(v.type_source));
    }
    if (!bits.length) return "";
    return '<p class="vf-src">' + bits.join(". ") + ".</p>";
  }

  // The register a column sits in decides how you join it and whether it is
  // still maintained. A searcher who lands on dodsaars.d_dodsdto needs to know
  // the register stops in 2001 before they use it for censoring.
  function regLine(id) {
    var r = REG[id];
    if (!r) return "";
    var bits = [];
    if (r.join_keys) bits.push("join on <code>" + esc(r.join_keys) + "</code>");
    if (r.coverage) bits.push(esc(r.coverage));
    if (r.timing) bits.push(esc(r.timing));
    if (r.cadence) bits.push(esc(r.cadence));
    // Not from DST: the cancer register and the laboratory table come through
    // Sundhedsdatastyrelsen's Forskerservice, on a separate application.
    if (r.scope === "sds") bits.push("<strong>Sundhedsdatastyrelsen, not DST</strong>");
    var warn = r.deprecated
      ? '<div class="vf-note vf-danger">Closed register' +
        (r.superseded_by ? ", replaced by <code>" + esc(r.superseded_by) + "</code>" : "") +
        ". Check it still covers your period.</div>"
      : "";
    var overlap = r.overlap_note
      ? '<div class="vf-note vf-danger">' + esc(r.overlap_note) + "</div>" : "";
    var joins = r.joins
      ? '<div class="vf-note">Joins to other registers: ' + esc(r.joins) + ".</div>" : "";
    var desc = r.description
      ? '<div class="vf-note">' + esc(r.description) + "</div>" : "";
    return '<div class="vf-meta">' + bits.join(" &middot; ") + "</div>" +
           desc + joins + warn + overlap;
  }

  // What a code means is the slow part of register work. The schema knows it,
  // so show it here rather than sending the reader to a classification page.
  function codeBlock(id) {
    var cs = id && CS[id];
    if (!cs) return "";
    var src = cs.source_url
      ? ' <a href="' + esc(cs.source_url) + '">' + esc(cs.source_name || "source") + "</a>" +
        (cs.source_page ? ' on <a href="' + esc(cs.source_page) + '">' +
          esc(cs.source_page.replace(/^https?:\/\/([^/]+).*$/, "$1")) + "</a>" : "") +
        // The CSV is the exact list. Worth linking: it is what you load when
        // you need the full set rather than the handful shown here.
        (cs.source_csv ? ' (<a href="' + esc(cs.source_csv) + '">CSV</a>)' : "")
      : "";
    var body;
    if (cs.values && cs.values.length) {
      body = '<table class="vf-codes"><tbody>' + cs.values.map(function (v) {
        return "<tr><td><code>" + esc(v.code) + "</code></td><td>" + esc(v.en) +
          (v.da && v.da !== v.en ? ' <span class="vf-da">' + esc(v.da) + "</span>" : "") +
          "</td></tr>";
      }).join("") + "</tbody></table>";
    } else {
      body = '<p class="vf-note">Too many codes to list here.' + (src ? " See" + src + "." : "") + "</p>";
    }
    return '<details class="vf-cs"><summary>' +
      (cs.values && cs.values.length ? cs.values.length + " values" : "Code system") +
      ": " + esc(cs.name || id) + "</summary>" + body +
      (cs.note ? '<p class="vf-note">' + esc(cs.note) + "</p>" : "") +
      (cs.values && cs.values.length && src ? '<p class="vf-note">Source:' + src + ".</p>" : "") +
      "</details>";
  }

  function render() {
    var words = q.value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_ -]/gu, " ")
                  .split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var terms = words.filter(function (w) { return STOP.indexOf(w) === -1 && w.length > 1; });
    if (!terms.length) terms = words;
    var expanded = {};
    terms.forEach(function (t) { expanded[t] = expand([t]); });
    var hits = DATA.filter(function (v) {
      if (!matches(v, terms, expanded)) return false;
      if (reg.value && v.register !== reg.value) return false;
      if (role.value && v.role !== role.value) return false;
      if (onlyKey.checked && !v.key) return false;
      if (onlyInf.checked && !v.type_inferred) return false;
      if (onlyPart.checked && !v.coverage) return false;
      return true;
    });

    // Group by column name: the same name in several registers is the finding.
    var groups = {}, order = [];
    hits.forEach(function (v) {
      if (!groups[v.name]) { groups[v.name] = []; order.push(v.name); }
      groups[v.name].push(v);
    });
    order.sort(function (a, b) {
      var d = groups[b].length - groups[a].length;   // shared names first
      return d !== 0 ? d : a.localeCompare(b);
    });

    count.textContent = hits.length + " column" + (hits.length === 1 ? "" : "s") +
      " in " + order.length + " name" + (order.length === 1 ? "" : "s") +
      " (of " + DATA.length + " columns in " + Object.keys(byName).length + " registers)";

    if (!hits.length) {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="vf-empty">Nothing matches. Try a shorter word, or the Danish label: ' +
        'the labels are DST\'s own and many are only in Danish.</p>';
      return;
    }

    out.innerHTML = order.slice(0, 300).map(function (name) {
      var g = groups[name];
      var multi = g.length > 1
        ? '<span class="vf-multi">in ' + g.length + ' registers, and not the same everywhere</span>' : "";
      var rows = g.map(function (v) {
        var tags = [];
        tags.push('<span class="vf-tag">' + esc(v.type) +
                  (v.type_inferred ? ", unverified" : "") + "</span>");
        tags.push('<span class="vf-tag">' + esc((v.role || "").replace(/_/g, " ")) + "</span>");
        if (v.coverage) tags.push('<span class="vf-tag vf-warn">' + esc(v.coverage) + "</span>");
        if (v.code_system) tags.push('<span class="vf-tag">codes: ' + esc(v.code_system) + "</span>");
        return '<div class="vf-hit">' +
          '<div class="vf-reg"><a href="' + esc(v.source_url) + '">' + esc(v.register) + "</a>" +
            regLine(v.register) + "</div>" +
          "<div>" + (v.label ? esc(v.label) : "<em>no label published</em>") +
          '<div class="vf-meta">' + tags.join("") + "</div>" +
          (v.origin ? '<p class="vf-note"><strong>' + esc(v.origin) + "</strong></p>" : "") +
          (v.superseded_by ? '<p class="vf-note vf-danger">Replaced by <code>' +
             esc(v.superseded_by) + "</code>. Using this one alone leaves a gap.</p>" : "") +
          (v.note ? '<p class="vf-note">' + esc(v.note) + "</p>" : "") +
          (v.derivation ? '<p class="vf-note">How it is computed: <code>' +
             esc(v.derivation) + "</code>" +
             (v.derivation_source ? ' <a href="' + esc(v.derivation_source) + '">source</a>' : "") +
             "</p>" : "") +
          (v.guide_page ? '<p class="vf-note">Explained in <a href="' +
             esc(v.guide_page.replace(/\.qmd$/, ".html")) + '">' +
             esc(v.guide_page.replace(/\.qmd$/, "")) + "</a>.</p>" : "") +
          codeBlock(v.code_system) +
          sourceLine(v) +
          "</div></div>";
      }).join("");
      return '<div class="vf-group"><span class="vf-name">' + esc(name) + "</span>" + multi + rows + "</div>";
    }).join("") + (order.length > 300
      ? '<p class="vf-empty">Showing the first 300 names. Narrow the search to see the rest.</p>' : "");
  }

  fetch("assets/variables.json")
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
      DATA = d.columns; CS = d.code_systems || {}; REG = d.registers || {};
      (d.synonyms || []).forEach(function (g) {
        g.forEach(function (t) {
          EXPAND[t.toLowerCase()] = g.map(function (x) { return x.toLowerCase(); });
        });
      });
      // The value labels are searchable too: "ugift" should find civst.
      Object.keys(CS).forEach(function (id) {
        var v = CS[id].values || [];
        CS[id]._text = v.map(function (x) {
          return x.code + " " + (x.en || "") + " " + (x.da || "");
        }).join(" ").toLowerCase() + " " + (CS[id].name || "").toLowerCase();
      });
      d.forEach(function (v) { byName[v.register] = v.register_name || v.register; });
      Object.keys(byName).sort().forEach(function (k) {
        reg.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",
          '<option value="' + esc(k) + '">' + esc(k) + "</option>");
      });
      var roles = {};
      d.forEach(function (v) { if (v.role) roles[v.role] = 1; });
      Object.keys(roles).sort().forEach(function (k) {
        role.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",
          '<option value="' + esc(k) + '">' + esc(k.replace(/_/g, " ")) + "</option>");
      });
      [q, reg, role, onlyKey, onlyInf, onlyPart].forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener("input", render);
      });
      render();
    })
    .catch(function () {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="vf-empty">The variable index could not be loaded. ' +
        "It is generated from the schema by <code>just build-schema-tables</code>.</p>";
    });
})();
</script>
```
